info.name: Triton Inference Server NVIDIA Triton Inference Server HTTP/REST CUDA Shared Memory Model Metadata API

description.content:
RESTful API for the NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, implementing the KServe V2 inference protocol with Triton-specific extensions. Provides endpoints for model inference, health checks, server and model metadata, model repository management, statistics, tracing, logging, and system shared memory management.
